findings.desc: Lattice-Engineering-Baseline-Unlock-Execution-Plan.md:186 defines digest-backed evidence refs as string refs using artifact:<file>#sha256=<64-hex>, and line 210 explicitly requires gateEvidenceRefs[] to use that string format. Section 10 then says any *EvidenceRefs entry is malformed if it is missing a digest field and line 806 requires refusalEvidenceRefs to have refusalType, which implies object-form entries. This is an internal contract contradiction for gate/refusal evidence refs and should block quality review until the document consistently specifies either digest-backed string refs or object refs.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by commit 54a96bbc. Section 10 no longer implies object-form evidence refs: it now says digest-backed evidence refs must use artifact:<file>#sha256=<64-hex>, sha mismatches block, and EXPECTED_BLOCK requires non-empty refusalEvidenceRefs. Verified with rg for object-form remnants: refusalType, missing digest field, { path, digest }, and gateEvidenceRefs[].gateType are absent from the document.

findings.desc: Coverage evidence is not replayable for CHK-001:edge:0 and CHK-002:adversarial:0. checklist_get records docs_check result=pass for `node -e "check document contains implementation-readiness/local diagnostic/audit-only proof boundaries"` and for `git diff --check main...HEAD && node -e "check stale/fake/localOnly/malformed/generic blockedReasons conditions"`, but replaying the node commands exits 1 with SyntaxError: Unexpected identifier. git diff --check main...HEAD passes and the document has matching content, but these verificationEvidence records claim PASS for commands that cannot execute, so coverage evidence must be replaced with executable rg/node checks or refreshed evidence before REVIEW can pass.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by commits eea72922 and 1f74a1ff. Replaced the non-executable node -e placeholder evidence commands with replayable rg/git diff checks: CHK-001:edge:0 now uses rg over implementation readiness/local diagnostic/host transcript/formal proof terms; CHK-002:adversarial:0 now uses rg over fail-closed categories plus git diff --check main...HEAD. Stale CHK-003 evidence was refreshed by e8218bb.
